description: Route 2: structure hunt of the exact D-ladder generating function D(ũ)=Σ d_k ũ^k (d_k ∈ ℚ(√3), O/h via the route-3 ser_div). Findings: (1) exact parity structure (odd k → √3-part carries the small denominator, even k → rational part); (2) 3-smooth simple-denominators (Ohtsuki/Habiro factorial normalization); (3) in the accessible window the root test is still rising with C=0.0617>0 in log|dₖ|=A+Bk+C·k·log k — CONSISTENT WITH the finite radius rather than evidence against it, since d_k = −(1/(2h*_ρ))ρ^(−k)/k approaches |dₖ|^(1/k) → 1/ρ from below and has not arrived by k=21; (4) no P-finite recurrence (order≤3 deg≤4; ORD-43 rules out order≤4 deg≤5) — which does NOT imply divergence; (5) the finite singularity IS present, at the Q_b zero q*_ρ≈1.48989, whose image under this probe's own ũ map reproduces the published ρ=0.142799996644689… . RE-SCOPED 2026-08-14: the 2026-07-12 'super-exponentially divergent (radius→0)' reading rested on an INCOMPLETE singularity search that omitted this root; see docs/audits/2026-08-09-dladder-is-convergent-radius-is-the-qb-zero.md. The exact d_k, the parity structure, the 3-smooth denominators and the non-holonomicity are all UNAFFECTED. Scope-(a); no wiring.

data.contrast_kappa_tower: RE-SCOPED 2026-08-14. The D-ladder is CONVERGENT (ρ = ũ(q*_ρ) = 0.142799996644689…, κ = 0; 2026-08-09 correction), so it is NOT in the κ-tower's family: the κ-tower is genuinely Gevrey-1 divergent (Borel singularity A≈0.7), this ladder is not. The 2026-07-12 claim of a shared divergent family is withdrawn. A divergent and a convergent series cannot be equated term-by-term — the corpus already carries that as a proved scope-(b) result.
data.non_holonomic_does_not_imply_divergent: The order≤3/deg≤4 negative in [4] constrains the ALGEBRAIC class only. φ(w)log(1−w/ρ)+ψ(w) with algebraic φ,ψ is convergent AND not low-order P-finite, so no growth-class conclusion follows from it.
